summary: Reproduced all three independent-review counterexamples at candidate commit aff03080588f3a879a4e5a8871523a224b8997a8 from https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/1249, as reviewed by https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/1328. The candidate accepted explicit strict:null but retained None in ResponsesRequest, ChatCompletionRequest, model_dump output, and the Responses-to-Chat conversion. The consolidated correction preserves nullable input acceptance while normalizing null to the established false default during validation.
